quotes.quote: I'm selfish, impatient and a little insecure. I make mistakes, I am out of control and at times hard to handle. But if you can't handle me at my worst, then you sure as hell don't deserve me at my best.
quotes.author: Marilyn Monroe

quotes.quote: Be yourself; everyone else is already taken.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: If you tell the truth, you don't have to remember anything.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.quote: I'm not upset that you lied to me, I'm upset that from now on I can't believe you.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: So, this is my life. And I want you to know that I am both happy and sad and I'm still trying to figure out how that could be.
quotes.author: Stephen Chbosky,  The Perks of Being a Wallflower

quotes.quote: The reason I talk to myself is because I'm the only one whose answers I accept.
quotes.author: George Carlin

quotes.quote: Humor is something that thrives between man's aspirations and his limitations. There is more logic in humor than in anything else. Because, you see, humor is truth.
quotes.author: Victor Borge

quotes.quote: Comedy has to be based on truth. You take the truth and you put a little curlicue at the end.
quotes.author: Sid Caesar

quotes.quote: When someone loves you, the way they talk about you is different. You feel safe and comfortable.
quotes.author: Jess C. Scott,  The Intern

quotes.quote: Filmmaking, like any other art, is a very profound means of human communication; beyond the professional pleasure of succeeding or the pain of failing, you do want your film to be seen, to communicate itself to other people.
quotes.author: Kenneth Lonergan

quotes.quote: The marks humans leave are too often scars.
quotes.author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

quotes.quote: She gave up beauty in her tender youth, gave all her hope and joy and pleasant ways; she covered up her eyes lest they should gaze on vanity, and chose the bitter truth.
quotes.author: Christina Rossetti

quotes.quote: I love you, and because I love you, I would sooner have you hate me for telling you the truth than adore me for telling you lies.
quotes.author: Pietro Aretino

quotes.quote: I've cried, and you'd think I'd be better for it, but the sadness just sleeps, and it stays in my spine the rest of my life.
quotes.author: Conor Oberst

quotes.quote: And you know, whether it's drama or comedy, the best work is based on truth. It's just that, with comedy, the circumstances are just crazy-heightened, and you have these crazy things thrown at you. But you still have to do it truthfully, because that's where the humor comes from. So it's not that difficult to cross over.
quotes.author: Tony Hale

quotes.quote: In everything I write, I'm always striving to hit the right mix of light and darkness, humor and pain, fun and seriousness.
quotes.author: Greg van Eekhout

quotes.quote: I believe that one key to success is to accept truth, no matter how it's spoken.
quotes.author: Robert Kiyosaki

quotes.quote: We have art in order not to die of the truth.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: The basis of art is truth, both in matter and in mode.
quotes.author: Flannery O'Connor

quotes.quote: A lie can travel half way around the world while the truth is putting on its shoes.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.quote: Never tell the truth to people who are not worthy of it.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.quote: It's so hard to forget pain, but it's even harder to remember sweetness. We have no scar to show for happiness. We learn so little from peace.
quotes.author: Chuck Palahniuk,  Diary

quotes.quote: The truth is rarely pure and never simple.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde,  The Importance of Being Earnest

quotes.quote: The truth."Dumbledore sighed. "It is a beautiful and terrible thing, and should therefore be treated with great caution.
quotes.author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone

quotes.quote: I believe that unarmed truth and unconditional love will have the final word in reality. This is why right, temporarily defeated, is stronger than evil triumphant.
quotes.author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quotes.quote: I know that some endeavor to throw the mantle of romance over the subject and treat woman like some ideal existence, not liable to the ills of life. Let those deal in fancy who have nothing better to deal in; we have to do with sober, sad realities, with stubborn facts.
quotes.author: Ernestine Rose

quotes.quote: Speak the truth, do not yield to anger; give, if thou art asked for little; by these three steps thou wilt go near the gods.
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.quote: You find out in life that people really like you funny. So what do you give 'em? Humor. And then if you show them the other side, they don't like you as much. I find, too, that I can hide behind the idiot's mask being funny, and you never see the sorrow or the pain.
quotes.author: Terry Bradshaw

quotes.quote: I've heard too many times where people say that I'm this ultra-serious guy. In truth, I've got an extremely absurd sense of humor. I thrive on the absurd - I love it.
quotes.author: Phil Anselmo

quotes.quote: The truth will set you free, but first it will piss you off.
quotes.author: Joe Klaas,  Twelve Steps to Happiness

quotes.quote: I think great humor lies in playing the truth of a situation. I see myself as a performer and that applies to a Greek drama or a modern comedy.
quotes.author: Brendan Coyle

quotes.quote: Numbing the pain for a while will make it worse when you finally feel it.
quotes.author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

quotes.quote: Art is the most beautiful of all lies.
quotes.author: Claude Debussy

quotes.quote: I think it's the pain and suffering that drive you to become an artist. The art itself should be the pain, sort of exorcising every demon and making you feel like you're a person that matters.
quotes.author: Marilyn Manson

quotes.quote: I am not pretty. I am not beautiful. I am as radiant as the sun.
quotes.author: Suzanne Collins,  The Hunger Games

quotes.quote: I refuse to accept the view that mankind is so tragically bound to the starless midnight of racism and war that the bright daybreak of peace and brotherhood can never become a reality... I believe that unarmed truth and unconditional love will have the final word.
quotes.author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quotes.quote: There is a sacredness in tears. They are not the mark of weakness, but of power. They speak more eloquently than ten thousand tongues. They are the messengers of overwhelming grief, of deep contrition, and of unspeakable love.
quotes.author: Washington Irving

quotes.quote: Drawing is the honesty of the art. There is no possibility of cheating. It is either good or bad.
quotes.author: Salvador Dali

quotes.quote: Reading 'Youth in Revolt' might have ruined my career because suddenly I wanted to abandon all the emotional truth of something and just go out far on a literary limb with completely implausible things that relied completely on voice and humor. And what saved me is realizing that I couldn't do that very well.
quotes.author: Rob Thomas

quotes.quote: When I despair, I remember that all through history the way of truth and love have always won. There have been tyrants and murderers, and for a time, they can seem invincible, but in the end, they always fall. Think of it--always.
quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi

quotes.quote: Stephen King has inspired me with his humor and honesty, and his admonition that the author's job is to tell the truth.
quotes.author: Barry Eisler

quotes.quote: Success is always something completely different to people. I feel like I've succeeded, if I'm doing something that makes me happy and I'm not lying to anybody.
quotes.author: Kristen Stewart

quotes.quote: Wine comes in at the mouth And love comes in at the eye; That's all we shall know for truth Before we grow old and die.
quotes.author: William Butler Yeats

quotes.quote: There is something terribly morbid in the modern sympathy with pain. One should sympathise with the colour, the beauty, the joy of life. The less said about life's sores the better.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: Every man has his secret sorrows which the world knows not; and often times we call a man cold when he is only sad.
quotes.author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

quotes.quote: Perhaps one did not want to be loved so much as to be understood.
quotes.author: George Orwell,  1984

quotes.quote: It's in literature that true life can be found. It's under the mask of fiction that you can tell the truth.
quotes.author: Gao Xingjian

quotes.quote: The great art of life is sensation, to feel that we exist, even in pain.
quotes.author: Lord Byron

quotes.quote: Facts do not cease to exist because they are ignored.
quotes.author: Aldous Huxley,  Complete Essays 2, 1926-29

quotes.quote: Philip Larkin has a tough honesty and sense of humor that I find irresistible, as a contemporary poet.
quotes.author: Robert Morgan

quotes.quote: The secret of success is learning how to use pain and pleasure instead of having pain and pleasure use you. If you do that, you're in control of your life. If you don't, life controls you.
quotes.author: Tony Robbins

quotes.quote: Honesty and loyalty are key. If two people can be honest with each other about everything, that's probably the biggest key to success.
quotes.author: Taylor Lautner

quotes.quote: Sure, I am funny and have a good sense of humor. Mostly, though, I just tell the truth. The internal dialogue people have in their heads - I just write it.
quotes.author: Kara Swisher

quotes.quote: Even in literature and art, no man who bothers about originality will ever be original: whereas if you simply try to tell the truth (without caring twopence how often it has been told before) you will, nine times out of ten, become original without ever having noticed it.
quotes.author: C. S. Lewis

quotes.quote: I believe in everything until it's disproved. So I believe in fairies, the myths, dragons. It all exists, even if it's in your mind. Who's to say that dreams and nightmares aren't as real as the here and now?
quotes.author: John Lennon

quotes.quote: Art is the most beautiful deception of all. And although people try to incorporate the everyday events of life in it, we must hope that it will remain a deception lest it become a utilitarian thing, sad as a factory.
quotes.author: Claude Debussy

quotes.quote: I think you still love me, but we can't escape the fact that I'm not enough for you. I knew this was going to happen. So I'm not blaming you for falling in love with another woman. I'm not angry, either. I should be, but I'm not. I just feel pain. A lot of pain. I thought I could imagine how much this would hurt, but I was wrong.
quotes.author: Haruki Murakami,  South of the Border, West of the Sun

quotes.quote: Why, when we know that there's no such thing as perfect, do most of us spend an incredible amount of time and energy trying to be everything to everyone? Is it that we really admire perfection? No - the truth is that we are actually drawn to people who are real and down-to-earth. We love authenticity and we know that life is messy and imperfect.
quotes.author: Brene Brown

quotes.quote: If my art has nothing to do with people's pain and sorrow, what is 'art' for?
quotes.author: Ai Weiwei

quotes.quote: To me, Ann Romney sounds like a better candidate than her husband. She put her MS into remission through horseback riding, alternative therapies, and a healthy diet. She knows how to pace herself. She has a sense of humor and an innate honesty, and her hair moves in the wind. Maybe she should run.
quotes.author: Patti Davis

quotes.quote: In truth, politeness is artificial good humor, it covers the natural want of it, and ends by rendering habitual a substitute nearly equivalent to the real virtue.
quotes.author: Thomas Jefferson

quotes.quote: Good humor is the health of the soul, sadness is its poison.
quotes.author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield

quotes.quote: Art lies by its own artifice.
quotes.author: Ovid

quotes.quote: I think that if I ever have kids, and they are upset, I won't tell them that people are starving in China or anything like that because it wouldn't change the fact that they were upset. And even if somebody else has it much worse, that doesn't really change the fact that you have what you have.
quotes.author: Stephen Chbosky,  The Perks of Being a Wallflower

quotes.quote: Here's all you have to know about men and women: women are crazy, men are stupid. And the main reason women are crazy is that men are stupid.
quotes.author: George Carlin,  When Will Jesus Bring The Pork Chops?

quotes.quote: Art is magic delivered from the lie of being truth.
quotes.author: Theodor Adorno

quotes.quote: Above all, don't lie to yourself. The man who lies to himself and listens to his own lie comes to a point that he cannot distinguish the truth within him, or around him, and so loses all respect for himself and for others. And having no respect he ceases to love.
quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky,  The Brothers Karamazov

quotes.quote: A thing is not necessarily true because a man dies for it.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: Light is meaningful only in relation to darkness, and truth presupposes error. It is these mingled opposites which people our life, which make it pungent, intoxicating. We only exist in terms of this conflict, in the zone where black and white clash.
quotes.author: Louis Aragon

quotes.quote: Honesty is the most single most important factor having a direct bearing on the final success of an individual, corporation, or product.
quotes.author: Ed McMahon

quotes.quote: In a time of deceit telling the truth is a revolutionary act.
quotes.author: George Orwell

quotes.quote: Life is pain, highness. Anyone who says differently is selling something.
quotes.author: William Goldman,  William Goldman: Four Screenplays

quotes.quote: Men occasionally stumble over the truth, but most of them pick themselves up and hurry off as if nothing ever happened.
quotes.author: Winston S. Churchill

quotes.quote: There is something inexpressibly sad in the thought of the children who crossed the ocean with the Pilgrims and the fathers of Jamestown, New Amsterdam, and Boston, and the infancy of those born in the first years of colonial life in this strange new world.
quotes.author: Alice Morse Earle

quotes.quote: Given the scale of trauma caused by the genocide, Rwanda has indicated that however thin the hope of a community can be, a hero always emerges. Although no one can dare claim that it is now a perfect state, and that no more work is needed, Rwanda has risen from the ashes as a model or truth and reconciliation.
quotes.author: Wole Soyinka

quotes.quote: Man is least himself when he talks in his own person. Give him a mask, and he will tell you the truth.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: Turn your wounds into wisdom.
quotes.author: Oprah Winfrey

quotes.quote: The unexamined life is not worth living.
quotes.author: Socrates

quotes.quote: The second one, the joint Truth and Friendship Commission, which we started now with Indonesia, that is the one that has been criticized; its terms of reference call for providing amnesty for those who cooperate in telling the truth. It does not lead to prosecution.
quotes.author: Jose Ramos-Horta

quotes.quote: I lie to myself all the time. But I never believe me.
quotes.author: S.E. Hinton,  The Outsiders

quotes.quote: Lying in bed would be an altogether perfect and supreme experience if only one had a colored pencil long enough to draw on the ceiling.
quotes.author: Gilbert K. Chesterton

quotes.quote: Never be afraid to raise your voice for honesty and truth and compassion against injustice and lying and greed. If people all over the world...would do this, it would change the earth.
quotes.author: William Faulkner

quotes.quote: Truth is stranger than fiction, but it is because Fiction is obliged to stick to possibilities; Truth isn't.
quotes.author: Mark Twain,  Following the Equator: A Journey Around the World

quotes.quote: The truth is that love smashes into your life like an ice floe, and even if your heart is built like the Titanic you go down.
quotes.author: Jeanette Winterson

quotes.quote: You think your pain and your heartbreak are unprecedented in the history of the world, but then you read. It was books that taught me that the things that tormented me most were the very things that connected me with all the people who were alive, or who had ever been alive.
quotes.author: James Baldwin

quotes.quote: Tell the truth, or someone will tell it for you.
quotes.author: Stephanie Klein,  Straight Up and Dirty

quotes.quote: The truth does not change according to our ability to stomach it.
quotes.author: Flannery O'Connor

quotes.quote: It's funny. People often compare me to other humor essayists. They're usually quite nice comparisons; I will accept those gladly. But I am always sort of appalled at the idea of being lumped with other, more chick-y female writers. And the truth is probably that neither comparison is accurate.
quotes.author: Sloane Crosley

quotes.quote: If pain must come, may it come quickly. Because I have a life to live, and I need to live it in the best way possible. If he has to make a choice, may he make it now. Then I will either wait for him or forget him.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  By the River Piedra I Sat Down and Wept

quotes.quote: Books are mirrors: you only see in them what you already have inside you.
quotes.author: Carlos Ruiz ZafÃ³n,  The Shadow of the Wind

quotes.quote: It's an art to live with pain... mix the light into gray.
quotes.author: Eddie Vedder

quotes.quote: Pain is temporary. Quitting lasts forever.
quotes.author: Lance Armstrong,  Every Second Counts

quotes.quote: Art is the lie that enables us to realize the truth.
quotes.author: Pablo Picasso

quotes.quote: The more I see, the less I know for sure.
quotes.author: John Lennon

quotes.quote: The worst part of holding the memories is not the pain. It's the loneliness of it. Memories need to be shared.
quotes.author: Lois Lowry,  The Giver

quotes.quote: The reason it hurts so much to separate is because our souls are connected.
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks

quotes.quote: It is amazing how complete is the delusion that beauty is goodness.
quotes.author: Leo Tolstoy,  The Kreutzer Sonata

quotes.quote: The most important kind of freedom is to be what you really are. You trade in your reality for a role. You trade in your sense for an act. You give up your ability to feel, and in exchange, put on a mask. There can't be any large-scale revolution until there's a personal revolution, on an individual level. It's got to happen inside first.
quotes.author: Jim Morrison

quotes.quote: The things you do for yourself are gone when you are gone, but the things you do for others remain as your legacy.
quotes.author: Kalu Ndukwe Kalu

quotes.quote: It is sad not to love, but it is much sadder not to be able to love.
quotes.author: Miguel de Unamuno

quotes.quote: There are wounds that never show on the body that are deeper and more hurtful than anything that bleeds.
quotes.author: Laurell K. Hamilton,  Mistral's Kiss

quotes.quote: And if there's any hope for America, it lies in a revolution, and if there's any hope for a revolution in America, it lies in getting Elvis Presley to become Che Guevara.
quotes.author: Phil Ochs

quotes.quote: Rather than love, than money, than fame, give me truth.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau,  Walden

quotes.quote: We all know that Art is not truth. Art is a lie that makes us realize the truth, at least the truth that is given to us to understand.
quotes.author: Pablo Picasso

quotes.quote: The truth is, unless you let go, unless you forgive yourself, unless you forgive the situation, unless you realize that the situation is over, you cannot move forward.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: The best way to find out if you can trust somebody is to trust them.
quotes.author: Ernest Hemingway

quotes.quote: So you're always honest,"I said."Aren't you?""No,"I told him. "I'm not.""Well, that's good to know, I guess.""I'm not saying I'm a liar,"I told him. He raised his eyebrows. "That's not how I meant it, anyways.""How'd you mean it, then?""I just...I don't always say what I feel.""Why not?""Because the truth sometimes hurts,"I said."Yeah,"he said. "So do lies, though.
quotes.author: Sarah Dessen,  Just Listen

quotes.quote: Some old wounds never truly heal, and bleed again at the slightest word.
quotes.author: George R.R. Martin,  A Game of Thrones

quotes.quote: There are three types of lies -- lies, damn lies, and statistics.
quotes.author: Benjamin Disraeli

quotes.quote: It's enough for me to be sure that you and I exist at this moment.
quotes.author: Gabriel GarcÃ­Â­a MÃ¡rquez,  One Hundred Years of Solitude

quotes.quote: It has been said, 'time heals all wounds.' I do not agree. The wounds remain. In time, the mind, protecting its sanity, covers them with scar tissue and the pain lessens. But it is never gone.
quotes.author: Rose Kennedy

quotes.quote: The truth about filmmaking is you have all these ideas and you're trying to convince everybody that they should buy into this idea, but at two o'clock in the morning when you're all on your own you're going, 'Geez, I hope I know what I'm doing. I hope this idea is gonna work.'
quotes.author: Gavid Hood

quotes.quote: In a girl I look for honesty above all, someone who I can carry on a conversation with, someone who has a good sense of humor, someone who's true to herself, and to top it, someone who can get ready for a date in less than ten minutes.
quotes.author: Erik von Detten

quotes.quote: Remember that wherever your heart is, there you will find your treasure.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  The Alchemist

quotes.quote: There are no facts, only interpretations.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: Humor comes in all forms, and everyone has their cup of tea about what makes them laugh. But the day we censor humor is a sad one for sure.
quotes.author: Marlee Matlin

quotes.quote: If you want to tell people the truth, make them laugh, otherwise they'll kill you.
quotes.author: George Bernard Shaw

quotes.quote: Blunders, no, only friendship binds us to honesty - attracting crypts of mushrooms in the wake of our snowboards.
quotes.author: Bradley Chicho

quotes.quote: Imagine smiling after a slap in the face. Then think of doing it twenty-four hours a day.
quotes.author: Markus Zusak,  The Book Thief

quotes.quote: It's discouraging to think how many people are shocked by honesty and how few by deceit.
quotes.author: NoÃ«l Coward,  Blithe Spirit

quotes.quote: He does something to me, that boy. Every time. It's his only detriment. He steps on my heart. He makes me cry.
quotes.author: Markus Zusak,  The Book Thief

quotes.quote: People worry about kids playing with guns, and teenagers watching violent videos; we are scared that some sort of culture of violence will take them over. Nobody worries about kids listening to thousands - literally thousands - of songs about broken hearts and rejection and pain and misery and loss.
quotes.author: Nick Hornby,  High Fidelity

quotes.quote: Achievement of your happiness is the only moral purpose of your life, and that happiness, not pain or mindless self-indulgence, is the proof of your moral integrity, since it is the proof and the result of your loyalty to the achievement of your values.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: My parents, and librarians along the way, taught me about the space between words; about the margins, where so many juicy moments of life and spirit and friendship could be found. In a library, you could find miracles and truth and you might find something that would make you laugh so hard that you get shushed, in the friendliest way.
quotes.author: Anne Lamott

quotes.quote: All you have to do is write one true sentence. Write the truest sentence that you know.
quotes.author: Ernest Hemingway

quotes.quote: Humor does not diminish the pain - it makes the space around it get bigger.
quotes.author: Allen Klein

quotes.quote: If you do not tell the truth about yourself you cannot tell it about other people.
quotes.author: Virginia Woolf

quotes.quote: Illegal aliens have always been a problem in the United States. Ask any Indian.
quotes.author: Robert Orben

quotes.quote: Love is the crowning grace of humanity, the holiest right of the soul, the golden link which binds us to duty and truth, the redeeming principle that chiefly reconciles the heart to life, and is prophetic of eternal good.
quotes.author: Petrarch

quotes.quote: And that's the thing about people who mean everything they say. They think everyone else does too.
quotes.author: Khaled Hosseini,  The Kite Runner

quotes.quote: No persons are more frequently wrong, than those who will not admit they are wrong.
quotes.author: FranÃ§ois de La Rochefoucauld

quotes.quote: One thing you can't hide - is when you're crippled inside.
quotes.author: John Lennon

quotes.quote: Humor is the instinct for taking pain playfully.
quotes.author: Max Eastman

quotes.quote: The past has no power over the present moment.
quotes.author: Eckhart Tolle

quotes.quote: We tell them that we believe it will be beautiful because that is our specialty, we only create joy and beauty. We have never done a sad work. Through the drawings, we hope a majority will be able to visualize it.
quotes.author: Christo

quotes.quote: The line between humor and bad taste is your audience, in which some people will find everything offensive, and some people will find nothing offensive, but the truth is that most humor originates in what would be called bad taste.
quotes.author: Robert Mankoff

quotes.quote: Pain insists upon being attended to. God whispers to us in our pleasures, speaks in our consciences, but shouts in our pains. It is his megaphone to rouse a deaf world.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis

quotes.quote: Well, darkness with humor... I'm not an extremely suicidal or sad person.
quotes.author: Peter Steele

quotes.quote: Tears shed for another person are not a sign of weakness. They are a sign of a pure heart.
quotes.author: JosÃ© N. Harris,  MI VIDA: A Story of Faith, Hope and Love

quotes.quote: What we have to do, what at any rate it is our duty to do, is to revive the old art of Lying.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: Humor is the truth; wit is an exaggeration of the truth.
quotes.author: Stan Laurel

quotes.quote: I have absolutely no pleasure in the stimulants in which I sometimes so madly indulge. It has not been in the pursuit of pleasure that I have periled life and reputation and reason. It has been the desperate attempt to escape from torturing memories, from a sense of insupportable loneliness and a dread of some strange impending doom.
quotes.author: Edgar Allan Poe

quotes.quote: The first ingredient in conversation is truth, the next good sense, the third good humor, and the fourth wit.
quotes.author: William Temple

quotes.quote: The most painful thing is losing yourself in the process of loving someone too much, and forgetting that you are special too.
quotes.author: Ernest Hemingway,  Men Without Women

quotes.quote: A truth that's told with bad intentBeats all the lies you can invent.
quotes.author: William Blake,  Auguries of Innocence

quotes.quote: One wordFrees us of all the weight and pain of life:That word is love.
quotes.author: Sophocles

quotes.quote: Better a cruel truth than a comfortable delusion.
quotes.author: Edward Abbey

quotes.quote: Madness is the absolute break with the work of art; it forms the constitutive moment of abolition, which dissolves in time the truth of the work of art.
quotes.author: Michel Foucault

quotes.quote: Thinking something does not make it true. Wanting something does not make it real.
quotes.author: Michelle Hodkin,  The Unbecoming of Mara Dyer

quotes.quote: I have learned now that while those who speak about one's miseries usually hurt, those who keep silence hurt more.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis

quotes.quote: Love is the only reality and it is not a mere sentiment. It is the ultimate truth that lies at the heart of creation.
quotes.author: Rabindranath Tagore

quotes.quote: Behind every beautiful thing, there's some kind of pain.
quotes.author: Bob Dylan

quotes.quote: Time was passing like a hand waving from a train I wanted to be on. I hope you never have to think about anything as much as I think about you.
quotes.author: Jonathan Safran Foer

quotes.quote: Don't bend; don't water it down; don't try to make it logical; don't edit your own soul according to the fashion. Rather, follow your most intense obsessions mercilessly.
quotes.author: Franz Kafka

quotes.quote: The only truth is music.
quotes.author: Jack Kerouac

quotes.quote: The truth is that there is only one terminal dignity - love. And the story of a love is not important - what is important is that one is capable of love. It is perhaps the only glimpse we are permitted of eternity.
quotes.author: Helen Hayes

quotes.quote: All good books are alike in that they are truer than if they had really happened and after you are finished reading one you will feel that all that happened to you and afterwards it all belongs to you: the good and the bad, the ecstasy, the remorse and sorrow, the people and the places and how the weather was. If you can get so that you can give that to people, then you are a writer.
quotes.author: Ernest Hemingway

quotes.quote: People fear death even more than pain. It's strange that they fear death. Life hurts a lot more than death. At the point of death, the pain is over. Yeah, I guess it is a friend.
quotes.author: Jim Morrison

quotes.quote: there are two types of people in the world: those who prefer to be sad among others, and those who prefer to be sad alone.
quotes.author: Nicole Krauss,  The History of Love

quotes.quote: Sometimes things become possible if we want them bad enough.

quotes.quote: Believe those who are seeking the truth. Doubt those who find it.

quotes.quote: Live your truth. Express your love. Share your enthusiasm. Take action towards your dreams. Walk your talk. Dance and sing to your music. Embrace your blessings. Make today worth remembering.

quotes.quote: Forever and ever, kid, until you're sick and tired of seeing me.
quotes.author: Marie Lu,  Legend

quotes.quote: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about its own things. Sufficient for the day is its own trouble. Matthew 6:34
quotes.author: Anonymous,  Holy Bible: King James Version

quotes.quote: We don't even ask happiness, just a little less pain.

quotes.quote: The question of truth is forever in the air, and people look for it with particular fervor in art.

quotes.quote: The Bible has noble poetry in it... and some good morals and a wealth of obscenity, and upwards of a thousand lies.

quotes.quote: There are ships sailing to many ports, but not a single one goes where life is not painful.

quotes.quote: I am certain of nothing but the holiness of the Heart's affections and the truth of the Imagination.

quotes.quote: Boredom: the desire for desires.

quotes.quote: The sense of unhappiness is so much easier to convey than that of happiness. quotes.quote: I can't set my hopes too high,'Cause every hello ends with a goodbye.

quotes.quote: A fit, healthy body--that is the best fashion statement

quotes.quote: Nothing is ever certain.

Whatever doesn't kill you makes you incredibly annoying.
